scope: Five illustrative assets from five resources; Fundus and OCT. Four unmodified distributed dataset image files and one complete published figure. These examples are not a training dataset or evidence of clinical performance.
redistribution_note: Each asset retains its own source license; the repository content license does not replace these terms. Preserve attribution and license links when reusing.
acquisition_note: Only ZIP central-directory ranges and individual selected members were fetched. No complete dataset archive was downloaded. ZIP member CRC32 was verified; SHA-256 refers to the actual image file included here.
